solutions.title: Longest compatible DP
solutions.strategy: Sort intervals and compute the largest non-overlapping subset ending at each interval.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every interval can be compared with every earlier interval.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP table stores one value per interval.

solutions.title: Greedy earliest end
solutions.strategy: Sort by end time and keep every interval that starts after or at the last kept end.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting dominates the linear selection pass.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Sorting may use recursion or temporary stack space.
